about_the_game:
Sometimes you just want to pretend like a meteor is going to destroy your house. The “End of the World as You Know It” map pack enables you to journey across real-world maps.

Get one last tropical vacation with Hawaiian Island, cross America’s last frontier with Alaskan Wilderness, cross the lower 48 with 48 States, visit the Big Apple with NYC, take that European vacation you always talked about with European Devastation, or cross the whole darn world with Worldwide End.

Unlocking this pack enables you to host games for all players of Journey Quest, even those who have not unlocked the pack themselves.
